marks.gloss_en: כי ביתו: מה ביתו אקפנדריא קפיד איניש, ארקיקה ומנעל לא קפיד איניש, אף בית הכנסת קפנדריא הוא דאסיר, רקיקה ומנעל שרי -- as in his own house a man objects to a shortcut but not to spitting and shoes, so the synagogue
so in a synagogue, a shortcut is forbidden
the nazir passage (Num 6) is juxtaposed to the sota passage (Num 5): whoever sees a sota in her disgrace should abstain from wine
the nazir passage is juxtaposed to the sota passage to tell you that whoever sees a sota in her disgrace should abstain from wine
the sota passage is juxtaposed to terumot and tithes ('every man's holy things shall be his' beside 'any man whose wife goes astray'): whoever withholds them will need the priest through his wife
the sota passage is juxtaposed to terumot and tithes to tell you: whoever has terumot and tithes and does not give them to the priest will in the end need the priest through his wife
כאותה ששנינו: זכריה בן קבוטל אומר: הרבה פעמים קריתי לפניו בספר דניאל -- the grandfather read before the High Priest, so the family served in the Temple
two scholars are sent after him; he asks: why have you come? they: we have come to learn Torah
והלא עקיבא בן יוסף היה מעבר שנים וקובע חדשים בחוץ לארץ! -- R' Akiva did the very thing you oppose me for
הנח רבי עקיבא, שלא הניח כמותו בארץ ישראל -- leave R' Akiva, who left none like him in the Land of Israel
אף אני לא הנחתי כמותי בארץ ישראל -- by your own distinction I am like R' Akiva
גדיים שהנחת נעשו תישים בעלי קרנים, והם שיגרונו אצלך -- the kids you left have become horned goats, and it is they who sent us to you
did not Akiva ben Yosef intercalate years and fix months outside the Land?
a person should never multiply friends in his house
a person should not appoint an administrator (apotropos) in his house
and if he gave them, in the end he grows rich
whoever joins the Name of Heaven to his distress, his livelihood is doubled for him
his livelihood flies to him like a bird
whoever slackens from words of Torah has no strength to stand on a day of distress
when Chanina, son of R' Yehoshua's brother, went down to the exile, he would intercalate years and fix months outside the Land
he began to declare impure and they declared pure; he forbade and they permitted
asked why they rule pure where he rules impure and permit where he forbids, they answer: because you intercalate years and fix months outside the Land
שנאמר: קומו ברכו את ה' אלהיכם מן העולם עד העולם
ואומר: ויברכו שם כבודך ומרומם על כל ברכה ותהלה
why all this [the closing formula]? because one does not answer amen in the Temple
תלמוד לומר: ומרומם על כל ברכה ותהלה -- על כל ברכה וברכה תן לו תהלה
one might think all the blessings together have a single praise
וכי תימא: בעז מדעתיה דנפשיה קאמר -- and if you say Boaz said it of his own accord
תא שמע: ה' עמך גבור החיל (Judg 6:12)
וכי תימא: מלאך הוא דקאמר ליה לגדעון -- and if you say it was an angel who said it to Gideon
תא שמע: אל תבוז כי זקנה אמך (Prov 23:22)
שמע מינה -- from 'where there is no man, be a man' it follows: where there is a man, do not be a man
bar Kappara: [when] it has become cheap -- jump, buy of it
Rava: this verse is expounded from its beginning to its end, and is expounded from its end to its beginning
beginning to end: 'a time to act for the Lord' -- why? because 'they have voided Your Torah'
Hillel the Elder: at the time of the gatherers -- scatter
it was needed only where the two are equal
bar Kappara: which is a small passage on which all the bodies of Torah depend? 'In all your ways know Him, and He will make your paths straight' (Prov 3:6)
bar Kappara: a person should always teach his son a clean and light craft
